title: didymostigma obtusum
intro: Didymostigma obtusum, commonly known as Qian Lie Zhong Tang or Chinese barometer bellflower, is a plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Didymostigma obtusum are attributed to its ability to promote sweating, relieve cough, and calm the mind, which are achieved through the modulation of neurotransmitters and hormone regulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenylethanoid glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
